name: customer-researcher
title: Customer Researcher
description: Research companies live in a driven browser and save verified findings to a Postgres table.

operations.name: open
operations.description: Open the researcher window and answer its surface; with input "docked", answer the surface only.

operations.name: research
operations.description: Research a company by name, location or website and answer the outcome.

operations.name: stop
operations.description: Stop active and queued research without removing saved records.

operations.name: result
operations.description: Answer the stored research row for a company query, or null.

settings.name: Browser
settings.description: The browser driver: empty for the window's own driven browser, or scripted/<key>.
